payload.summary: Follow-up to PR 3546: Codex's held native PDF provenance change and pre-claim upload refusal
payload.detail: Codex's reference branch codex/pr3546-f04-candidate (f04c841c4) carries two changes held out of PR 3546. 1) Native PDF provenance in the PDF extractor, a protected RAG input producer, so it needs owner notice, a RAG impact line and a named yes. 2) A 503 refusal before claiming when the worker is not ready, which would reverse the owner decision of 2026-10-16 to leave that behaviour alone. Owner chose on 2026-10-16 to do both in a separate follow-up PR after 3546, each checked on its own.
